name: TRENCHES
desc:
Welcome to TRENCHES a chaotic large scale 25v25 TPS based on the trenches in the first world war.
- Fight In some of history's bloodiest and most fearsome battles! ☠️ 
- Mass scale combat with your friends! 📸 
- Level up and unlock new weapons! ⚔️ 
- Check our Game passes and expand your player experience! 💰 
- Push across the battlefield towards victory! 💂🏼 

Don't forget to drop a like and favorite on Trenches to show your support! 

Thank you for getting Trenches to 100K Likes! 
Use code "100KLikes"  in settings to get 3000 cash! Next code on 150,000 likes!

Join the Trenches social media to find more codes! 

Trenches Supports PC 🖥️ Mobile 📱 and Console 🎮 

Premium Benefits: 
- 20% EXP Boost
